items.rationale: The theft damaged the bike, which is scheduled at an agreed value of EUR 3,500 (4.4), so the mobility sub-limit of EUR 500 is replaced for this item. A frame replacement is a repair under 7.1.7. The frame is the main cost. Rough estimate of about 650 EUR.
Brake damage from the theft is a repair cost on the scheduled bike. The agreed value replaces the sub-limit, so a normal brake price applies.
Carriage of parts is a repair element under 7.1.7(f) and is indemnified with the repair.
Attendance of the trade is part of the repair under 7.1.7(g).
Fitting the replacement parts is part of the repair under 7.1.7(c).
Sundry materials consumed by the repair are covered under 7.1.7(e), but small lines like this were often judged to be low.
Apprentice labour on the repair is covered under 7.1.7(d). Rate taken from the reference level of about 35 EUR per hour.
Skilled labour for the frame and brake repair is covered under 7.1.7(d). One hour at a normal rate.
Attendance at the place where the bike was found to cut the lock off is a recovery cost under 5.2.2(a). The reference range was about 34 to 45 EUR.
Cutting the lock is recovery work under 5.2.2(b). The reference showed at least 100 EUR is fair.
Sundry materials consumed by the lock cutting are recovery costs under 5.2.2(b), but the reference showed under 9 EUR.
Apprentice labour on the lock cutting is covered under 5.2.2(b). The reference range was about 35 to 36 EUR.
Skilled labour for cutting the lock is a recovery cost under 5.2.2(b). The reference showed under 45 EUR for one hour, so this is placed just below that.
